affectedPublicSurfaces: every authenticated /v1 route — all of them currently 401 under juli_app

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: /v1/demo/runs on the candidate, exercised with a minted short-lived JWT

journeys.name: an-authenticated-read-succeeds-under-juli_app
journeys.entryUrl: GET /v1/demo/runs with a valid bearer token and X-Shop-Id
assertions: the body carries the shop's runs rather than an empty list
the connected role is juli_app, not an owner

journeys.name: isolation-is-not-widened
journeys.entryUrl: repository-level check on the deployed connection
assertions: get_for_authentication for a different user id returns nothing
the plain get with no scope is still refused
total rows visible inside the scope is exactly 1

journeys.name: the-scope-does-not-leak
journeys.entryUrl: the same request continuing into get_active_shop
assertions: app.current_user_id is restored after the lookup
no shop GUC is set by the authentication step

htmlRoutes: not-applicable: API-only change, no HTML route

migrationCompatibility.notes: No schema change and no policy change. The existing users_select_public policy is left exactly as it is; the application now sets the GUC that policy already reads.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: revert to 91f783d6; the authenticated surface returns to 401-for-everyone, which is the current state and loses nothing

doNotInfer: Do not read this as end-to-end auth verification — no login surface is deployed, so Supabase's own login remains untested (PLAN.md, PR #1692)
Do not widen the scope to the plain `get`: the exception is deliberately a separate, greppable method so it cannot spread
Do not move the scope into core/security/dependencies.py — ADR-085 decision 2 keeps the tenant seam out of that module, which is why it lives in the repository
Do not relax the users_select_public policy; the policy is correct and is what preserves isolation inside the scope
